Calendar Principal's Message Infinite Campus Staff Directory News Resources Prairie View Middle School Prairie View Middle School serves students in sixth through eighth grade in Orland Hills, Orland Park, and Tinley Park, IL. We are committed to working in partnership with our community to build a safe, respectful, and nurturing environment where students are equipped with skills for life and learning.
